messages:
maya.hewitt: Quick sync — I noticed a few inconsistencies in wording across the SDK examples and the main API pages. Specifically: some pages say 'call the model', others say 'invoke model'. Can we pick one term for the docs? :thinking_face:
eli.chen: +1 on standardizing. I prefer `invoke` for public-facing docs (less ambiguous). For internal SDK method names we can keep historical names but surface a migration note.
sam_g: Agreed on `invoke` for docs. Also saw a mismatch in param casing in the JS snippet: `modelName` vs `model_name`. That will confuse users migrating between SDKs.
zach: @maya.hewitt can you list the top 3 pages where this shows up? I can batch a PR for link fixes and snippet updates.
maya.hewitt: Yep — found them: docs/sdk/js/quickstart.md, docs/api/overview.md, docs/guides/migrations/param-casing.md. I'll paste one JS snippet where casing differs:
```js
// old example
const res = await sdk.call({ modelName: 'redwood' });
// new example we want
const res = await sdk.invoke({ model_name: 'redwood' });
```
eli.chen: Thanks. For clarity: public docs should show the recommended pattern (`invoke`, `model_name`) and we should include a short migration note: "If you currently use `call`/`modelName`, here's a mapping table."
docs-bot: PR opened by @zach: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1398 - updates quickstart + fixes links. CI: lint + linkcheck queued.
lina: Quick UI/console note — Console still shows "Call model" in the dropdown. Should sync copy there too or it will confuse users.
sam_g: Good catch. Is Console copy owned by product or docs?
maya.hewitt: Product owns Console copy, but we can propose the update. I'll draft a short message for product and link the PR.
zach: I pushed a small commit to PR #1398 replacing `call` -> `invoke` in examples and added a migrations stub. Left two TODOs for product/console text.
eli.chen: Can we add a glossary entry for the terms? Something like: `invoke (v) — to send a request to a model via Redwood API; call — legacy SDK method name (see migration).`
maya.hewitt: I'll add the glossary entry in docs/glossary/terminology.md in the same PR. Also adding an anchor for product to reference.
docs-bot: CI passed for docs lint, linkcheck found one broken link in docs/guides/migrations/param-casing.md — broken anchor to `#param-casing`.
sam_g: I'll fix the anchor now.
zach: Can we set a short rollout plan? My suggestion: merge docs PR once product confirms Console copy or we add a temporary parenthetical: "(labelled Call in Console)" next to new instances. Then ship migration guide.
maya.hewitt: Timeline: aim to merge by EOD Thursday. Product confirmation by Wednesday noon. If no block, update Console copy in a follow-up.
eli.chen: I'll draft the migration table here for review (short):
- `call` -> `invoke`
- `modelName` -> `model_name`
- `maxLen` -> `max_length`
Add a short note about lower_snake_case preference in examples.
lina: Product approves the rename to `invoke` for user-facing text. We'll queue Console change for the next release.
maya.hewitt: Great — I'll update PR #1398 with glossary entry, migration table, and a small note near snippets: "Console label remains 'Call' until next release."
sam_g: Fixed the anchor; re-ran linkcheck locally, all good.
docs-bot: PR #1398 updated, checks green. Reviewer request to @eli.chen and @sam_g.
eli.chen: Reviewing now. Minor nit: in quests/example.md we should add a one-line explanation of why we prefer `invoke` (clarity for non-dev readers).
maya.hewitt: Added that line.
zach: If the review is quick, I'll merge and we can post an internal changelog note.
maya.hewitt: Perfect. Once merged I'll update the phrasebank and notify i18n team for translations. :sparkles:
